entries.00d71405f10f5623: It sets as its mission "continuing to move people through management and becoming an entity needed by the community and society," and as its management purpose "sharing a sense of happiness with all people involved with the company." In its long-term vision through 2030, the "ICHIBANYA Long-Term Vision 2030," it sets the figure it aims to be as a "food entertainment company," and in the 8th Medium-Term Management Plan (the fiscal year ended February 2025 to the fiscal year ended February 2027) it sets out to use domestic CoCo ICHIBANYA as a growth engine to increase net sales per 1 store and the number of stores, to expand its store network overseas, centered on Asia and North America, through the FC system, and to develop new business formats in its domestic subsidiary businesses using M&A. In response to soaring purchase prices for rice and increases in personnel and logistics costs, the medium-term management plan has been revised. The plan's target figures are matters concerning the future, so they are not reproduced here.
